prompt: Create an ultra-realistic soft editorial portrait of NaEun, a young East Asian woman with shoulder-length light brown bob hair with a soft side part, sitting in a dense field of tiny white wildflowers and green stems. Frame her from the upper chest upward, centered slightly left, surrounded by flowers in the foreground and background; some blossoms should be close to the lens and softly blurred, partially crossing her face and shoulders for depth. She wears a simple strapless white summer dress, bare shoulders visible, minimal jewelry, natural dewy makeup, soft pink lips, calm melancholic expression, and direct eye contact with the camera. Use dreamy natural daylight, pale green and white color palette, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, gentle wind moving a few strands of hair, realistic skin texture, delicate feminine mood, high-end Korean beauty photography, 85mm lens look, f/1.8, vertical 3:4 composition. Add subtle translucent watermark-style text: a faint handwritten signature reading “NaEun & Damien” across the upper center and lower center, plus vertical side watermarks repeating “♥ NaEun & Damien 2026” along both left and right borders. Keep the image photorealistic, soft, airy, romantic, and clean, with no harsh contrast and no extra people.

promptZh: 创作一张超写实的柔美编辑类人像，主角为 NaEun，一位年轻的东亚女性，留着 浅棕色齐肩波波头，带有柔和的侧分，坐在一片茂密的白色小野花和绿茎丛中。构图采用从胸部以上的中景，略微偏左，前景和背景均被花朵环绕；部分花朵靠近镜头并呈现柔和的虚化效果，部分遮挡在她的脸部和肩部以增加景深。她身穿简约的白色抹胸夏装，露出双肩，佩戴极简首饰，妆容自然水润，唇色呈柔和的粉色，表情平静忧郁，直视镜头。采用梦幻般的自然日光，以淡绿色和白色为主色调，浅景深，奶油般虚化的背景，微风拂动几缕发丝，呈现真实的皮肤质感，营造细腻的女性化氛围，高端韩国美学摄影风格，85mm 镜头质感，f/1.8 光圈，3:4 竖构图。添加微妙的半透明水印式文字：在上方中心和下方中心处添加模糊的手写签名“NaEun & Damien”，并在左右两侧边缘添加重复的竖排水印“♥ NaEun & Damien 2026”。保持图像的写实感、柔和感、空气感、浪漫感和纯净感，避免强烈的对比度，且画面中不应出现其他人物。
